description: NorESM Climate modeling Consortium (NCC) consists of Norwegian institutions MET-Norway, NORCE, NERSC, UiB, UiO, NILU and CICERO with a joint ambition to develop and maintain the Norwegian Earth System Model (NorESM) as a cutting-edge climate model and contribute to future Coupled Model Intercomparison Projects, climate assessment reports and scenario computations for climate services.
